bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 100 日均线，位于 30 日均线

read.en: AMD rose 7.3% on Nov 11 to $552.90, trading $522.65–567.65 on heavy volume (1.40x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($486.0), 10-day ($494.1), 100-day ($526.7), 200-day ($420.1) and, just, the 30-day ($550.9); only the 200-day is rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($404.84), and RSI is 53.6.

The close cleared the 100-day ($526.7) and the $539.25 Nov 10 high and closed on the 30-day; the $567.65 high stopped short of $574–579. Resistance is $561.5–567.7 (Jul 22 high, Nov 11 high), then $574.2–579.2 (Jul 14 and Oct 28 highs) and $584.7. Support is $539.3–550.9, then $522.7–526.7 (Nov 11 low, 100-day) and $495–503. A close above $567.7 would target $574–579; below $539, $523–527.
